mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand for durable goods, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and reduces equity valuation risk, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST shows two consecutive monthly increases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output below 100 (INDPRO) indicates supply constraints that increase input costs and inflation expectations, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) increases expectations of monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL shows two consecutive monthly increases.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding $350 billion (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate synchronized consumer demand acceleration that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both rise.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth below 1.5% annualized (GDPC1) indicates slowing economic momentum that reduces corporate earnings expectations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5%.
